# To Issues

## What it does

Turn plans into observable GitHub issues.

## When to reach for it

A plan or finding needs high-level, observable issues published to GitHub.

## Where it fits

Use when the tracker artifact is the primary deliverable rather than an implementation ticket chain. The catalog stage is `tickets`. Previous stages: None.

## Prerequisites

- `github` (mcp): GitHub is the publication surface for issues and relationships.

## It is working if

- Every issue has an observable outcome and traceable evidence.
- Requested native relationships are confirmed or explicitly reported as unavailable.

## Invocation

Use `$to-issues` when you want this skill explicitly. It is available for implicit selection.
